source:
@@U02276@@
What he promises will benefit all. Where it comes from the military man isn't prone to question.

@@U02278@@
And if you think I’ve been less than truthful, here’s another, the Astrologer! Question him! If anyone knows the heavens, he does, every sphere, every circle, the mansions, the hours. Tell us, then, sir, how it looks up there.

@@U02280@@
—What a pair of rogues. —lIt’s a conspiracy. —A fool and a dreamer. —And so near the throne. —The same old song. —The Fool prompts. —The Sage speaks.

@@U02282@@
(Speaks, 梅菲斯特 prompts.)

@@U02283@@
The Sun himself is purest gold; Mercury, his messenger, run errands if well paid; Lady 维纳斯 has bewitched you in youth and age, smiling kindly down upon you; chaste Luna is changeable and full of caprice; if Mars doesn’t fail to strike, he threatens with bluster. 朱庇特’s shine is still the brightest, while 萨图尔努斯 so far away seems small; as metal we don't honor him much, but for his weight, a weight very great. Ah, but when Luna and Sol accord, gold with silver, all’s well with the world!
translation:
@@U02276@@
他的承诺将使所有人受益。它来自军人的哪里，这一点不容置疑。

@@U02278@@
如果你认为我不太诚实，这里还有另一个，占星家！质问他！如果有人知道天空，他知道每一个球体、每一个圆圈、大厦、时间。那么，先生，告诉我们上面的情况如何。

@@U02280@@
——真是一对无赖啊。 ——这是一个阴谋。 ——一个傻瓜和一个梦想家。 ——距离王座如此之近。 ——同样的老歌。 ——愚者提示道。 ——圣人说话了。

@@U02282@@
（梅菲斯特提示说，说话。）

@@U02283@@
太阳本身是最纯金的；水星，他的使者，如果报酬丰厚，就会跑腿；维纳斯女士无论年轻还是年老，都让你着迷，她对你温柔地微笑；贞洁的露娜多变，反复无常；如果火星没有失败，他就会用咆哮来威胁。 朱庇特的光芒依然是最亮的，而萨图尔努斯那么远就显得渺小；作为金属，我们不太尊重他，但就他的重量而言，重量非常大。啊，但是当卢娜和索尔和谐相处，金与银，世界一切都好！
